summary: feat(admin-panel): add bulk account disable page
description:
Because:

* Admins can reset accounts in bulk but disable only one at a time.

This commit:

* Adds POST /api/account/bulk-disable for up to 1000 emails or UIDs
* Revokes tokens, sets disabledAt and logs each disable, with no email
* Adds the BulkDisableAccounts permission at the Admin level
* Adds the admin panel Account Disable page with text file upload
* Shows an error when the file read fails, and checks the test re-enable

Closes FXA-14910
